observation.visible_scene: A static night-time exterior shot. On the left is the brightly lit classical entrance portico and upper facade of the 'E-DA ROYAL HOTEL'. On the right dominates a large Ferris wheel outlined in red/pink lights, with a triangular support structure at its base. Below the wheel is an illuminated sign with Chinese characters, and to the right are palm trees wrapped in blue lights plus warm yellow street lamps, all against a black sky.
visible_changes: The camera and all foreground elements (hotel, columns, sign, palm trees, lamps) keep fixed screen positions throughout the excerpt; there is no camera pan or zoom.

The red illumination pattern on the wheel's spokes and rim visibly reconfigures frame to frame: bright lit segments and a small lit quadrilateral/triangular highlight appear at different angular positions on the wheel (e.g. near the left rim in the early frames, near the top in the middle frames, back toward the left near the end), indicating an animated/sweeping light display on the wheel.
The wheel's structural (white) spokes show a slight change in orientation between the first and last sampled frames, consistent with the wheel turning slowly rather than being frozen.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the wheel's rotation and the light animation continue beyond this ~1.3 s crop, and what preceded the first frame (both ends are arbitrary cut points).
The full period of the lighting cycle and the wheel's true rotation speed.
uncertain_details: Direction and exact magnitude of the physical wheel rotation are hard to separate from the moving LED highlight; the bright pattern that shifts around the wheel may be an animation of the lighting rather than a single lit cabin.
Whether the small moving lit box is a gondola or an illuminated spoke segment is not resolvable from these frames.
